summary.text: Gloristine Brown is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 8 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former mayor of Bethel, she is the House Democratic Whip.

paragraphs.text: Brown lives in Bethel, North Carolina, and earned a B.S. in computer information systems and a master of public administration from Strayer University in 2013.
Her career experience includes working in the nursing and insurance industries.

Brown served as a commissioner on the Bethel town board and as mayor of Bethel, and she became a Pitt Community College trustee and joined the executive board of the North Carolina Association of Community College Trustees.
She assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Kandie Smith.
The General Assembly's website lists her as House Democratic Whip, representing Pitt County.
In the 2025-2026 session she is a member of the Appropriations, Education - K-12, Higher Education, and Housing and Development committees, among others.
